Author: CorkedFever
Name: Tavern Games
Punchline: Dice and bluffing games to play with other players in-game.
Description: A collection of tavern games (Liar's Dice, Pig, Mia, Blackjack, Hold'em, Roulette and more). Create or join a room with a short code, fill seats with bots, and let onlookers spectate. Open with /tavern.
